test_read_csv_from_url: test read_csv reads CSV data from an HTTP server URL with separator options

test_read_csv_with_pathlib: test read_csv reads CSV using pathlib Path objects with round-trip serialization
test_read_csv_nonexistent_path: test read_csv raises FileNotFoundError with helpful message for missing files
test_read_csv_no_permission: test read_csv raises PermissionError when file has no read permissions

test_read_csv_temporary_file: test read_csv reads from an open temporary file handle with whitespace separator
test_read_csv_preserves_file_handle: test read_csv does not close user-provided StringIO or file handles
test_read_csv_invalid_buffer: test read_csv raises ValueError when passed an invalid file buffer object
test_read_csv_buffer_without_seek: test read_csv accepts StringIO subclass that lacks seek and tell methods
test_read_csv_stringio_bytesio: test read_csv reads from StringIO and BytesIO handles without closing them
test_read_csv_memory_map_compression: test read_csv memory maps compressed CSV files with mmap support
test_read_csv_context_manager: test read_csv TextFileReader context manager closes handles on exit
